dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Shale arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, they have been observed to be highly anxious, noted to be heavily panting, and vocalizing throughout the assessment. Shale is also reported to escalate to biting the leash and thrashing briefly. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Shale
